issues.title: AIS: define zero-weight path handling under nested supports
issues.body:
The draft `data/curated/AnnealedImportanceSampling.yaml` on `goal/discover-ai-concepts-round308` permits nested supports but writes the raw density-ratio product without defining zero-weight paths. With f0=f1=(1,0), f2=(1,1), and identity T1, a base draw in state 1 encounters 0/1 followed by 0/0. The mathematically correct path contribution is zero.

Define zero-weight termination before later ratio evaluation, or explicitly narrow the maintained domain. Add a finite counterexample/guard check (expected mean weight 1/2), synchronize the report mirror, append history, and save a same-key successor review after required checks.

Evidence: Neal, arXiv physics/9803008v2, Section 2, PDF pp. 4–6, Equations 4–11. Found in a supporting subagent mathematical audit and confirmed by the author; this is a local representation defect, not an allegation against the source.

issues.title: AIS: correct Equation 2 definition locator to PDF page 2
issues.body:
The draft AIS definition evidence cites self-normalized Equation 2 on PDF page 3. In the exact inspected arXiv physics/9803008v2 PDF (SHA-256 6ae14b83d623438355c2de17a5e830d67a07fd5331b2eb997b82ed40174745cc), Equation 2 is on printed/PDF page 2. The author visually confirmed that page.

Correct the maintained locator and report mirror, append actual history, and retain the issue key in a successor review. The concept identity and formula are unchanged.

issues.title: AIS: qualify the intermediate-state indexing note at the initial draw
issues.body:
The draft AIS limitation repairs the source paragraph by saying x_j follows T_(j+1), but this only applies through j=n−2. The top state x_(n−1) is drawn directly from p_n, as the maintained main path correctly states; T_n is not applied.

Restrict the note to 0<=j<=n−2 and explicitly retain the initial-draw exception. Synchronize its report mirror, append history, and save a same-key successor review. Evidence: Neal arXiv physics/9803008v2, Equation 4 on PDF page 5 and intermediate-distribution paragraph on page 6.

result.scope: Finite exact laws and counterexamples only. No continuous-state theorem certification, variance bound, benchmark replication, author implementation, paid provider or training.

scope: Correct maintained AIS curation and its exact report/calculation mirrors. Initial review and supporting audit remain immutable. Final same-key dispositions await the full gate and source reassessment.
